Verification Summary Report — Amplitude Control

This report summarises the verification of the amplitude control requirements: for each requirement in its scope, the protocols that verify it, their executions and results. The procedures are in DOC-0004 and their executions are reported in DOC-0005.

A Verification Summary Report is a type of its own that extends Document: the matrix below is its template's, so every report of this type lays out its scope the same way. The report holds only this prose and its scope, a query for every approved requirement, so a requirement approved later is in the next export of this report without editing it.
